full_judgment:
Mohammad Anwarul Haque J.:- This criminal petition for leave to appeal is directed against the order of granting bail dated 22.02.2010 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Misc. Case No. 22080 of 2010 of the accused-petitioner in a Metro. Session Case No. 6251 of 2010 arising out of G. R. No. 152 of 2010 corresponding to Mohammadpur P.S. Case No. 20 dated 15.03.2010 punishable under section 8 & 9 of the Santras Birodhi Ain, 2009. 

 3. In short, the case of the prosecution is that the informant on the basis of secret information arrested the accused-petitioner from Mohammadpur area on 14.03.2010 in the midnight and recovered some Ziahadi Book from his custody for which the FIR was lodged and ultimately on investigation police report was submitted with a recommendation to stand trial of the accused-petitioner for committing the offence punishable under sections 8 and 9 of the Santras Birodhi Ain, 2009. 

 4. On refusal to grant bail by the learned Sessions Judge the accused-petitioner filed a Criminal Misc. Case in the High Court Division under section 498 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and obtained the impugned order of bail with an observation that no sanction has been obtained as required under section 40 of the Santras Birodhi Ain, 2009 neither in the stage of investigation nor in the stage of taking cognizance; as such the very case is itself not sustainable.
